name: ruflo
description: The original agent meta-harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems with adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes integrations.
one_liner: A free add-on that lets a coding AI assistant coordinate many specialized 'helper agents' working together on a task, and remember lessons learned across sessions.
buyer: A technical founder running a small dev team who wants their AI coding assistant to handle bigger, multi-part tasks (like a full feature build) without babysitting every step.
business_use_cases: A small dev agency uses it to run several specialized agents (one for tests, one for docs, one for refactoring) in parallel on a client project, shrinking delivery time.
A solo founder building an MVP uses the memory/learning features so the AI stops repeating the same mistakes across a multi-week build.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid setup and tuning of multi-agent swarms for specific client codebases, since the configuration surface is large (98 agents, 60+ commands).
Sell a curated, opinionated preset ('swarm configs for SaaS startups') as a paid template pack.

steal_this: This is powerful but has a steep learning curve for non-experts — the realistic weekend project is a short paid video course showing how to configure one useful swarm workflow end to end, not a new product.
